title: Hungjao Without Telephones As Thievs Cut Cables

page_data.en:
CHINA PRESS

FEB 14 1939

More Crime In The West
Hungjao Without Telephones
As Thieves Cut Cables

Residents of the Hungjao area are today cut off from telephonic communication with the rest of Shanghai as the result of another telephone cable theft staged in the district Sunday morning.

Looters, whose identities are still unknown, removed 30 feet of the main cable, containing 404 wires, from the district and thereby subscribers were cut off from telephone service.

An alarm received at the Lucerne Telephone Exchange at 9.10 p.m. Sunday indicated that the main Hungjao cable was being interfered with, a Shanghai Telephone Company report of the affair stated.

Prompt investigation showed that the cable had been cut in no less than four places on Great Western Road between Fraser and Warren Roads. The thieves also cut the supporting strand wires, causing two poles to collapse.

Officials of the Shanghai Telephone Company last night stated that everything is being done to restore the service as soon as possible. It is not anticipated, however, that the service will be fully restored until some time Wednesday morning.

This is the 14th theft of telephone cable that has occurred in the Hungjao district since May 1938, resulting in the isolation of telephone subscribers as well as a large financial loss to the company.

《字林西报》

1939年2月14日

西区罪案增多
窃贼切断电缆
虹桥电话中断

由于周日上午该地区又发生一起电话电缆盗窃案，虹桥地区居民今日与上海其他地区的电话通信被切断。

身份尚不明知的劫匪从该地区拆走了包含404根线芯的主电缆30英尺，从而导致用户电话服务中断。

上海电话公司关于此事的报告称，周日晚9时10分，卢塞恩（Lucerne）电话交换局接到警报，显示虹桥主电缆遭到破坏。

迅速调查显示，电缆在哥伦比亚路（Great Western Road）上介于弗雷泽路（Fraser Road）和沃伦路（Warren Road）之间的路段至少有四处被切断。窃贼还切断了支撑钢绞线，导致两根电线杆倒塌。

上海电话公司官员昨晚表示，正在采取一切措施尽快恢复服务。然而，预计直到周三上午某个时候才能完全恢复服务。

这是自1938年5月以来虹桥地区发生的第14起电话电缆盗窃案，导致电话用户与外界隔绝，并给公司造成巨大的经济损失。

Misc.No.455/38.
"B"
Bubbling Well
4th. November 38.

1.

THEFT OF TELEPHONE CABLE FROM WEST OF RAILWAY
LINE.
--------------------------------------------------
On 4-11-38 a letter dated 31st October 1938 from
the Shanghai Telephone Co., was received at this Station,
reporting the theft of telephone cable.
The letter states that on 23-10-38, 700 ft. of 101
pr. cable value $700.70, was stolen from Poles No.25-30
on Macleod Road.
The theft was not previously reported to Bubbling
Well Station.
Duties have been warned to keep a lookout for any
person bringing in scrap copper and lead from West of
the railway line.
Stolen Property Return attached herewith.
Copy to:
D.C. (Divisions).
D.C. (Special Branch).

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 5/11/38）

H.S. Greenfield
D. S. 37.
C.D.C.278.

Sen. Det. i/c.

杂项编号 455/38。
“B”区
静安寺
1938年11月4日。

1.

铁路以西电话电缆被盗案。
---
本分局于1938年11月4日收到上海电话公司1938年10月31日来信，报告电话电缆被盗。
信中称，1938年10月23日，麦考尔路（Macleod Road）第25至30号电线杆上价值700.70美元的101对电缆700英尺被盗。
此前未向静安寺分局报告此盗窃案。
已警告执勤人员留意任何从铁路以西携带废铜和铅进入的人员。
附失物清单副本。
抄送：
各分区副巡官（D.C. (Divisions)）。
特务处副巡官（D.C. (Special Branch)）。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务处 1938年11月5日）

H.S. Greenfield
警佐 37号。
C.D.C.278。

高级侦探主管

"B"
Misc. No. 448/38.     Jubilee Hall
                      2nd. November       38.
1.

THEFT OF POWER COMPANY POLES FROM SIDE OF
THE RAILWAY LINE.
------------------------------------------
At 5.20 p.m. 2-11-38, Mr. A. Tom of the Western
Supply Co. (Shanghai Power Co.) came to the Station and
reported that at 3 p.m. 2-11-38, it had been discovered
that three wooden poles, the property of his company,
had been stolen from Hungjao Road near Rubicon Road.
    The poles, Mr. Tom stated, had been sawn off at
the base, and to enable the poles to be easily
removed, the thieves had also sawn off the upper
portion to which the cable supports were bolted.
    Duties have been warned to stop any person of
doubtful character in possession of newly sawn timber.
    Copy to:
            D.C. (Divisions).
            D.C. (Sp. Branch).

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH）

                                                H.B. Greenfield.
                                                D. S. 37.

Sen. Det. i/c.

D.D.U. "B" Div.

杂项编号 448/38。      jubilee Hall（音译：禧厅/纪念堂）
                      1938年11月2日
1.

铁路旁电力公司电线杆被盗案。
---
1938年11月2日下午5时20分，西方供应公司（上海电力公司）的A. Tom先生来到分局报告称，1938年11月2日下午3时，发现其公司所有的三根木杆在虹桥路靠近鲁比肯路（Rubicon Road）附近被盗。
Tom先生称，电线杆底部被锯断，为了便于搬走，窃贼还将固定电缆支架的上部锯断。
已警告执勤人员拦截任何持有新锯木材的可疑人员。
抄送：
            各分区副巡官（D.C. (Divisions)）。
            特务处副巡官（D.C. (Sp. Branch)）。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务处）

                                                H.B. Greenfield.
                                                警佐 37号。

高级侦探主管

“B”区副总监
